source.selection: All dated monthly G17 HTML releases from fixed index; exclude annual revisions and supplements. Accept canonical path with or without final slash; December3,2025 link has none. Calendar metadata only may include2026, filtered before source-value requests.
source.series: Seasonally adjusted manufacturing month-on-month percent change, last preliminary observation column of Industrial Production summary, resolved via explicit headers. Labels Manufacturing (see note below) and Manufacturing* are the two observed footnote formats. Not total IP, utilities, mining, capacity utilization, index-level return, prior estimate or YoY.
source.availability: end of actual dated publication day New York plus1hour; conditional archive proxy, not witnessed receipt. Observation month never becomes publication date.
source.special_calendar: September2025 preliminary publishedDecember3; October andNovember preliminary jointlyDecember23. Use latest observation (November), never create fictional separate earlier releases. Annual revisionNovember24 excluded. Default40dayrelease TTL expires during the gap.
source.fetch: 93new public GETs serial >=1s;3probe release copies reused with metadata; no retry,redirect,credentials. Max3MBperHTML. Failure blocks economics; original archives may have later global notices. Only dated release table is a feature.
source.attribution: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Industrial Production and Capacity Utilization (G.17), each dated release; interpretation solely TradingLab research. Federalreserve.gov disclaimer checked, original Board materials generally public domain. No third-party microdata.

signal.mechanism: Published expansion of real manufacturing activity can indicate stronger industrial energy demand; test whether this information improves a BR long/cash allocation over matched-calendar constant-long BR. Hypothesis, not assumed causality or independence from macro beta.
signal.primary: BR long0.9gross iff latest published manufacturing monthly change >0; zero/negative =>cash
signal.control: BR constant long0.9gross on exactly the same valid-source calendar; control cannot be promoted after outcomes
signal.decision: 18:45Moscow after completed information day, execution next factual daily open; no same-bar entry or future-exit eligibility filter
